description: Managed device driver for the NETIO PDU.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: NETIO header, stock Cognio controls, outputs and metering laid out as tables.
Connect Offline replaces the Connect, Disconnect and Auto-Connect buttons: online the driver always polls the PDU; offline it polls only while Connect Offline is on.
Connected lights only while the PDU answers its status poll; outputs and names are sent only while it is lit, and the totals readouts now show the PDU totals.
